payload.description:
Investigate the generic LangGraph/Jinja rendering boundary using repository code, sanitized fixtures, synthetic experiments, Git history, and primary upstream sources.

Deliverable: document required template capabilities, exposed data types and trust boundaries, behavior of the restricted environment, risks of a global unrestricted-environment override, and a recommended supported design with alternatives.

Constraints: no production fix, no production configuration inspection or edits, no client information, and no deployment activity.
payload.title: Investigate safe dynamic-state access in YAML score templates
